title: John Mack at Harvard, his friend Bud Hopkins and Thomas Kuhn's advice

tellings.quote: John Mack was the head of the Harvard psychiatry department in the '9s. and he was actually childhood friends with a guy named Bud Hopkins

plain: In the 1990s, Jesse Michels says, a psychiatrist named John Mack headed the psychiatry department at Harvard and had been friends since childhood with a man named Budd Hopkins. Michels brings this up himself, without naming a source, while talking with a neuroscientist about strange experiences. The story is linked to the thinker Thomas Kuhn and some advice he gave, but Michels does not say what that advice was. It matters to him because it puts a senior Harvard psychiatrist close to the study of people who say they were taken by aliens.
